title: InitConfigOutput
description: Report printed by the `init-config` subcommand: which files were written, skipped or would be written under `--dry-run`. Distinct from `config.schema.json`, which describes the CONTENT of those files rather than the report about them. English-only: these keys are command diagnostics, not search-result fields. Added in v1.0.3 — the README had carried this as a known-absent schema since the subcommand shipped.

type.description: Envelope discriminator (v1.0.4+). This envelope carried none, so the published catalog could not route it. Emitted by `types::InitConfigKind`, a compiler-checked constant.

dry_run.description: `--dry-run` was active: nothing was written to disk.

force.description: `--force` was active: existing files were overwritten instead of skipped.

base_directory.description: Config directory used (XDG / Application Support / APPDATA, or `--config-home` verbatim).

files.description: One entry per target file, in a stable order: `selectors.toml` then `user-agents.toml`.

file_report.description: Outcome for one file. `action` is an internally tagged enum, so `error` carries an extra `message` and the other variants carry nothing.

path.description: Absolute path of the target file.

action.description: `skipped` means the file already existed and `--force` was not passed. The two `would_*` values only appear under `--dry-run`.

message.description: Present only when `action` is `error`; a write failure for one file does not abort the others.
